# Taxottic

> Taxottic is tax-forecasting software for freelancers, independent contractors, sole proprietors, and small businesses in the United States. It connects to your bank, keeps a running quarterly estimated-tax forecast in step with your income, and surfaces IRS-cited deductions — so self-employed filers can set money aside before it's due and claim everything they're legally owed. Made by Techno Optics LLC. Lives at https://taxottic.com.

Taxottic ("tax" + the "-ottic" suffix it shares with its sibling product Advottic) turns the once-a-year scramble of self-employment taxes into a calm, always-current picture. Instead of guessing at quarter-end, you see what you'll likely owe today and how each deduction changes it.

What it does:
- Bank-synced quarterly estimated-tax forecasts (federal + state) that update as money moves
- A catalog of 1,025 IRS-cited deductions, each linked to its IRC section and IRS publication
- Automatic Schedule C assembly with PDF export for your CPA
- Multi-state forecasting, QBI (Qualified Business Income) math, and AMT detection
- Quarterly estimated-tax reminders so you never miss a due date
- Automatic business-mileage tracking (phone + Wear OS watch) at the IRS standard rate
- Receipt and document OCR via its built-in assistant, "Bella"
- Tax year 2026 with OBBBA (One Big Beautiful Bill Act) amendments

Who it's for: self-employed people and small businesses — 1099 contractors, freelancers, gig workers, sole proprietors, single-member LLCs, S-corps — and the accounting firms that serve them. It is a forecasting and organization tool, not a filing service, and not a substitute for advice from a licensed CPA or tax attorney.
